messages.subject: checkboxInput spacing
parts:
Is it possible to change the spacing of the checkboxInput?  I have attached a screenshot where I have two textInput boxes and a checkboxInput next to them.  I want the each checkbox to lineup with the corresponding row.  I have attached a screenshot. You can ignore the horizontal spacing of the objects;  I am only concerned withe the vertical spacing of the checkbox.  Below is how I am generating the checkboxInput.  Thanks!  - Josh

      output$deleteAssets <- renderUI({
        assetVector <- as.data.frame(getTickers1())
        n = nrow(assetVector)
        assetVector <- as.data.frame(assetVector[-n,])
        n = n-1
        
        n = n + nEditAssets$i
        deleteInput <- vector("list",n)   
        for(i in 1:n){
          deleteInput[[i]] <- list(checkboxInput(inputId = paste0("deleteAsset",i), label = "", value=FALSE))
        }   
        deleteInput
      })
